decision.explanation: Both Lyon and Paris have a '1st arrondissement' as described in the provided sources. Document D1S1 explicitly states that the 1st arrondissement of Lyon is part of the City of Lyon. Similarly, Document D2S1 states that the 1st arrondissement of Paris is part of the capital city of France. These are distinct referents (two different cities) with the same name (1st arrondissement), and both are valid answers to the question. There is no contradiction between them because they refer to different cities.
